Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness. The
reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces expected in a collision of this type, and the presenting symptoms are
plausible given that mechanism. Over the course of fifteen visits, care followed a typical conservative pathway that included
manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instructions. Treatment intensity was reudced in a stepwise fashion as
symptoms improved and function returned. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle
tenderness, which support the reported soft tissue injury, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within
normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body regions is known to this office. Billing records reflect single,
appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. At discharge the patient was improving and was
advised to continue an independent home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsen.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
